.bash_completions/aps.sh:
_aps_completion() {
    local IFS=$'
'
    COMPREPLY=( $( env COMP_WORDS="${COMP_WORDS[*]}" \
                   COMP_CWORD=$COMP_CWORD \
                   _APS_COMPLETE=complete_bash $1 ) )
    return 0
}

complete -o default -F _aps_completion aps

.zshrc:
fpath+=~/.zfunc; autoload -Uz compinit; compinit

zstyle ':completion:*' menu select
